annotations.title: List what changed since the reader read it

description: List the documents the reader has read before whose blocks changed since they last read them, newest change first - what they have to catch up on; with path, only that document or those under that folder. Use it for what changed for the reader; for every change in the folder over a period, read or not, use folio_digest, and for the marks on one page folio_reads with its path. It reveals which documents the reader has read. While the reader pauses sharing in Folio, it answers only {paused: true, message}. Answers {documents: [{path, blocks: how many changed, at: ISO time of the latest change}], version: the same while the list is}. A list cut to fit one answer adds omitted, the entries each list left out, and narrow, how to ask for less.

path.description: A document, relative to the served folder or absolute under it, such as notes/plan.md, or a folder, such as notes/; omit for the whole folder
